rules.statement: Swing High is three consecutive candles where both adjacent highs are lower than the center high.
Swing Low is three consecutive candles where both adjacent lows are higher than the center low.
A three-candle swing becomes knowable only after the right-hand candle closes.
Bullish trend has highs and lows above previous; bearish trend has lows and highs below previous.
Machine structure requires chronological/interleaved swing pairing so unrelated same-side swings are not combined into artificial HH/HL or LL/LH structure.
Bullish structure BOS breaks the protected key minimum/HL; bearish structure BOS breaks the protected key maximum/LH with candle-body acceptance beyond the level.
CONF is a later update of the key minimum/maximum of the new structure after BOS. Exact machine anchor selection remains a technical normalization.
External liquidity is at structural highs/lows and beyond range boundaries; internal liquidity is inside a formed impulse/range between structural endpoints on the corresponding timeframe.
A confirmed swing strictly inside already-known structural endpoints is context-labelled INTERNAL; endpoint/outside evidence is EXTERNAL. Context label is excluded from physical pool stable identity.
EQH/EQL form between substructure swings, not arbitrary candles.
EQH may be tilted with left maximum above right; EQL may be tilted with left minimum below right.
The source allows tilt within reason but provides no numeric tolerance. No automatic percentage/ATR/tick threshold is authorized.
A deterministic sweep is represented as strict wick penetration beyond a known pool. Exact touch alone is not a sweep. The source does not provide a machine close-vs-wick threshold.
